goal_text: Find the bug in this JavaScript function that retrieves the first admin user. Identify the line number, bug category, and propose the exact fix.
ground_truth: Bug at line 3: 'return admin.name' when 'Array.find()' returns undefined (no admin found). Accessing .name on undefined throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined. Category: null dereference. Fix: add a null check — 'return admin ? admin.name : null' or 'return admin?.name'.

rubric.check_text: Proposes null check or optional chaining
